## Problem and audience

## Proposed trigger boundary

When should it load, and when should it not load?

## Existing overlap

Which current skill is closest, and why is it insufficient?

## Incrementality hypothesis

What concrete behavior, decision, calculation, safety boundary or output should improve compared with no skill or the current skill? How could that difference be checked?

## Evidence and sources

Use links/citations. Do not paste unlicensed books, articles or private material.

## Evaluation approach

Describe synthetic, non-sensitive cases and the model/harness you would test. Do not include private holdouts or full private answers.
